RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Demographic composition alone is not evidence of discrimination. In banking, an all-female panel is often coincidental, and for a leadership role like Head of Risk Modelling, regulatory experience and executive stakeholder management frequently outweigh technical depth or academic credentials. 

Raising gender bias based purely on the panel's composition is legally weak and risks severely damaging your reputation across a specialized industry. 

A two-week delay for written feedback is common in corporate HR. Follow up politely to request constructive feedback on how to strengthen your candidacy for future leadership roles. Keep the inquiry strictly focused on your interview performance and skill alignment rather than demographic factors.
